metadata.description: Flow: Claude plans, builds and opens the PR; you approve the plan and merge. deep-dives: interactive design sessions where you make every call.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Runs every coding task through one loop: Claude plans, builds, reviews, and opens the PR. You approve the plan and you merge the PR. Skeptical reviewers check the plan, the "done" claims, and any step Claude skipped.

plugins.name: deep-dives
plugins.description: Interactive design sessions where Claude facilitates and you make every call. Each skill runs one designer's approach as a working session (first up: Josh Puckett's uncommon care), for incubating ideas rather than shipping production code.
